core.title: Seashell Cabinet Door Pull, RK International CP-413

text.description_html:
RK International CP-413, 3" Shell Cabinet Knob

An elegant way to bring the natural elements of beach decor to your home is this Seashell Cabinet Door Pull. All three available finishes really bring out the subtle chicness that a well-designed beach theme can have. The shells at the ends of this pull have just enough texture to be a point of interest. It comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Also Available Matching CK-216 Shell Cabinet Knob

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP-413 Seashell Cabinet Hardware:

  • Material: Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-1/4"
  • Width: 1-1/8"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
